template.title: The Glowing Moss and the Kind Request
template.summary: A child named [[slot_child]] learns to ask for help when a toy gets stuck, turning a small problem into a big adventure.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with his [[slot_pet]] in the park.
One day, [[slot_child]] found a shiny dollhouse [[slot_toy]] near a big oak tree.
He wanted to bring it home, but the dollhouse slipped into a small hole.
[[slot_child]] tried to pull it out with his hands, but the hole was too deep.
Then he used a stick, but the dollhouse stayed stuck.
[[slot_child]] felt sad and thought about throwing the dollhouse away.
But he remembered his promise to be kind, so he decided to ask the park keeper for help.
The keeper smiled and used a tiny shovel to pull the dollhouse out.
When the dollhouse appeared, it was covered in [[slot_color]] moss that glowed like a lantern.
[[slot_child]] and his [[slot_pet]] shared the dollhouse with a new friend, a small hedgehog named [[slot_friend]].
From then on, [[slot_child]] learned that asking for help can turn a small problem into a big adventure.
